settings.heading: Easy Finance Option Buy Now Pay Later
settings.body_text: At Sofa-Direct, we make things simple and easy for our customers. Our buy now, pay later service allows you to spread the sofa purchase into an easy payment plan via PayPal, DivideBuy, ClearPay and Klarna. It’s the same premium furniture, just with a flexible payment plan that gives you a little more breathing room.

settings.name: Klarna
settings.tagline: Purchase now and pay in 30 days, or pay in 3 interest-free instalments.
settings.features:
No interest or fee if you pay on time
Instant eligibility check (age 18+ and UK resident)
Manage payments in the Klarna app

settings.name: Clearpay
settings.tagline: Pay in 4 interest-free instalments, every 2 weeks.
settings.features:
No interest or fees when paid on time
Fast approval at checkout
Automatic payments every 2 weeks

settings.name: PayPal
settings.tagline: Spread the cost of your purchase in 3 interest-free payments over 2 months
settings.features:
No interest & no setup cost
Soft credit check with fast decision
Manage payments via the PayPal App

settings.name: DivideBuy
settings.tagline: Spread the cost over 3–12 months. Interest-free options available.
settings.features:
Quick application with instant decision
Flexible terms and amounts
Direct Debit setup available
